blind.description: A stylized low-poly wooden holding cell gate set within a thick rectangular wooden frame. The door section features vertical wooden bars and a central horizontal crossbeam. Iron hardware includes two black strap hinges on the left, a lock plate with a hanging padlock on the right front, and a dark curved handle on the reverse side. The wood is textured in a warm medium-brown finish with stylized bevels and grain, and all iron fixtures are dark charcoal grey. Surfaces are solid, clean, and properly joined with no floating or broken parts.
blind.from_above: A narrow horizontal wooden beam between two slightly larger square post tops, with small dark metal fixtures protruding from the front and back faces.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 4.8 feet tall (slightly shorter than the 5 ft 9 in figure) and roughly 3.2 feet wide.
